# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Deceased

## Appearance

Opal Pettigrew was a woman who was brutally murdered, her body discovered hidden within an old trunk. The gruesome state of her remains made a stark and disturbing impression on those who investigated her disappearance.

## Personality

Little is shown of Opal's living personality directly, as she is primarily defined by the tragedy of her murder. Her life and interactions are pieced together retroactively through the testimony of acquaintances and investigators.

## History

Opal Pettigrew became the center of a murder investigation after her mysterious disappearance. Her corpse was later discovered concealed inside a trunk, leading investigators to uncover the dark circumstances surrounding her death. The unraveling of her case exposed key motives and connections involving those who knew her.
